title: Eggplant and Three Cheese Lasagne
subtitle: with smoky eggplant tomato sauce
description: Lasagne layered with a sauce of smoky charred eggplant and tomato, a mix of cheddar, parmesan and feta, and topped with mozzarella.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C (fan-forced). Roast the eggplants for about 40 minutes until the skin is charred, turning them during roasting (or char them over the stovetop). Take them out, place in a colander, and lower the oven to 200°C. When cool enough to handle, peel, roughly chop and drain in the colander.
Heat the olive oil, sliced garlic, oregano and finely chopped chilli in a wide pan over low-medium heat and fry for 3 to 4 minutes. Add the eggplant flesh and fry for about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, sugar, chopped parsley and salt and stir. Cook uncovered for about 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Mix all the cheeses (cheddar, parmesan and feta) in a bowl.

Pour some of the eggplant and tomato sauce into the base of a 20 x 30 cm baking dish, scatter over a third of the cheese mix and cover with lasagne sheets. Repeat for 3 layers of lasagne sheets in total and finish with a layer of sauce. Top with sliced mozzarella, cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and return to the oven for 10 more minutes until browned. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.
